column2:
sad(adj.)難過的、悲傷的
sadness(n.)悲傷
sadly(adv.)悲傷地、遺憾地
feel sad 感到難過
sad news 令人難過的消息
She felt sad when her dog got sick.
(她的狗生病時，她感到很難過。)
It was a sad movie about a lost boy.
(那是一部關於一個走失男孩的悲傷電影。)

safe(adj./n.)安全的、保險箱
safety(n.)安全
safely(adv.)安全地
safe and sound 平安無事
keep... safe 保護⋯安全
Please stay safe on your way home.
(回家路上請注意安全。)
He keeps his money in a safe.
(他把錢放在保險箱裡。)

salad(n.)沙拉
(無詞性變化)
fruit salad 水果沙拉
salad dressing 沙拉醬
I had a green salad for lunch.
(我午餐吃了一份生菜沙拉。)
Mom made a big fruit salad for the party.
(媽媽為派對做了一大盆水果沙拉。)

sale(n.)出售、特價拍賣
sell(v.)賣
on sale 特價中、出售中
for sale 待售
These shoes are on sale today.
(這些鞋子今天特價。)
The old house is now for sale.
(那棟老房子現在要出售。)

salt(n./v./adj.)鹽、加鹽、鹹的
salty(adj.)鹹的
a pinch of salt 一小撮鹽
salt water 鹽水
Please pass me the salt.
(請把鹽遞給我。)
Add a little salt to the soup.
(在湯裡加一點鹽。)

same(adj./pron./adv.)相同的、同樣的事物
(無詞性變化)
the same as 和⋯一樣
at the same time 同時
We go to the same school.
(我們上同一所學校。)
My bag is the same as yours.
(我的包包跟你的一樣。)

save(v.)拯救、節省、儲存
saving(n.)節省、存款(常用複數 savings)
save money 存錢
save time 節省時間
He saved a little girl from the river.
(他從河裡救起一個小女孩。)
I want to save money for a new bike.
(我想存錢買一台新腳踏車。)

say(v.)說
saying(n.)諺語、俗話
say hello to 向⋯問好
say goodbye 道別
What did the teacher say?
(老師說了什麼？)
Please say hello to your parents for me.
(請替我向你父母問好。)

school(n./v.)學校、教育
schooling(n.)學校教育
go to school 上學
high school 高中
I walk to school every morning.
(我每天早上走路上學。)
My brother is a high school student.
(我哥哥是高中生。)

science(n.)科學
scientist(n.)科學家
scientific(adj.)科學的
science class 自然科學課
computer science 電腦科學
Science is my favorite subject.
(自然科學是我最喜歡的科目。)
We did a fun test in science class.
(我們在自然課做了一個有趣的實驗。)

sea(n.)海、海洋
(無詞性變化)
by the sea 在海邊
sea level 海平面
We swam in the sea last summer.
(我們去年夏天在海裡游泳。)
They live in a small house by the sea.
(他們住在海邊的一間小房子裡。)

season(n.)季節
seasonal(adj.)季節性的
rainy season 雨季
four seasons 四季
Which season do you like best?
(你最喜歡哪個季節？)
Taiwan has a rainy season in May.
(台灣在五月有梅雨季。)

seat(n./v.)座位、使就座
(無詞性變化)
take a seat 坐下
window seat 靠窗座位
Please take a seat and wait here.
(請坐下在這裡等一下。)
I want a window seat on the plane.
(我在飛機上想要靠窗的座位。)

second(adj./n./adv.)第二的、秒、第二地
secondly(adv.)其次
second floor 二樓
wait a second 等一下
My room is on the second floor.
(我的房間在二樓。)
Wait a second, I can't find my key.
(等一下，我找不到我的鑰匙。)

secretary(n.)祕書
(無詞性變化)
personal secretary 私人祕書
secretary general 祕書長
The secretary answered the phone.
(祕書接了電話。)
She works as a secretary in a bank.
(她在一家銀行當祕書。)

see(v.)看見、明白、見面
sight(n.)視力、景象
see a doctor 看醫生
I see. 我明白了。
I can see the mountains from my window.
(我從窗戶可以看到山。)
You should see a doctor about your cough.
(你應該為了咳嗽去看醫生。)

seed(n.)種子
(無詞性變化)
plant seeds 播種
sunflower seeds 葵花子
We planted some seeds in the garden.
(我們在花園裡種了一些種子。)
Birds like to eat sunflower seeds.
(鳥喜歡吃葵花子。)

sell(v.)賣、銷售
seller(n.)賣方、銷售者
sale(n.)出售
sell out 賣完
sell well 暢銷
That shop sells fresh bread.
(那家店賣新鮮的麵包。)
The concert tickets sold out in one hour.
(演唱會門票一小時內就賣完了。)

send(v.)寄、送、派遣
sender(n.)寄件人
send a message 傳訊息
send for 派人去請
I will send you a message tonight.
(我今晚會傳訊息給你。)
She sent a card to her grandmother.
(她寄了一張卡片給她奶奶。)

sentence(n./v.)句子、判決、宣判
(無詞性變化)
make a sentence 造句
a prison sentence 徒刑
Please make a sentence with this word.
(請用這個字造一個句子。)
The man was sentenced to two years in prison.
(那名男子被判刑兩年。)

serious(adj.)嚴重的、認真的、嚴肅的
seriously(adv.)嚴重地、認真地
serious problem 嚴重的問題
be serious about 對⋯認真
Are you serious or just joking?
(你是認真的還是在開玩笑？)
Air pollution is a serious problem here.
(空氣汙染在這裡是個嚴重的問題。)

service(n.)服務
serve(v.)服務、供應
customer service 客服
service station 加油站、服務站
The service in this restaurant is great.
(這家餐廳的服務很好。)
Please call customer service for help.
(請打電話給客服尋求協助。)

set(v./n.)放置、設定、一套
setting(n.)背景、設定
set the table 擺餐具
set up 設立、架設
The sun sets in the west.
(太陽從西邊落下。)
Can you help me set the table?
(你可以幫我擺餐具嗎？)

several(adj./pron.)幾個、數個
(無詞性變化)
several times 好幾次
several days 幾天
I have read this book several times.
(這本書我讀過好幾次。)
Several students were late this morning.
(今天早上有幾個學生遲到。)

shake(v./n.)搖動、顫抖、搖晃
shaky(adj.)搖晃的、不穩的
shake hands 握手
milk shake 奶昔
They shook hands after the game.
(比賽後他們握了手。)
Shake the bottle before you drink it.
(喝之前先搖一搖瓶子。)

shall(aux.)將、要(用於提議)
(無詞性變化)
Shall we...? 我們要不要⋯？
Shall I...? 要我⋯嗎？
Shall we go to the park?
(我們要不要去公園？)
Shall I open the window for you?
(要我幫你開窗嗎？)

shape(n.)形狀、狀態
(無詞性變化)
in good shape 狀況良好
in the shape of 呈⋯形狀
The cake is in the shape of a heart.
(這個蛋糕是心形的。)
My grandpa is still in good shape.
(我爺爺身體狀況還很好。)

share(v./n.)分享、分擔、一份
(無詞性變化)
share with 和⋯分享
share an idea 分享想法
I share a room with my sister.
(我和我妹妹共用一個房間。)
Let's share this pizza together.
(我們一起分這個披薩吧。)

sharp(adj./adv.)鋒利的、尖銳的、(時間)整
sharpen(v.)削尖、磨利
sharply(adv.)急劇地、嚴厲地
a sharp knife 一把鋒利的刀
at seven sharp 七點整
Be careful, the knife is very sharp.
(小心，這把刀很鋒利。)
The class starts at eight sharp.
(課程八點整開始。)

she(pron.)她
her(pron.)她(受格)、她的
hers(pron.)她的(東西)
herself(pron.)她自己
by herself 她獨自
she and I 她和我
She is my best friend.
(她是我最好的朋友。)
She made the cake by herself.
(她自己做了這個蛋糕。)

sheep(n.)羊、綿羊(單複數同形)
(無詞性變化)
a flock of sheep 一群羊
count sheep 數羊
There are many sheep on the farm.
(農場上有很多綿羊。)
I count sheep when I can't sleep.
(我睡不著的時候會數羊。)

ship(n./v.)船、運送
shipping(n.)運輸、運費
by ship 搭船
ship the goods 運送貨物
They went to the island by ship.
(他們搭船去那座島。)
The store will ship the book to you.
(店家會把書寄送給你。)

shirt(n.)襯衫
(無詞性變化)
dress shirt 正式襯衫
a white shirt 白襯衫
He wears a white shirt to work.
(他穿白襯衫去上班。)
I bought a new T-shirt yesterday.
(我昨天買了一件新的T恤。)

shoe(n.)鞋子(常用複數 shoes)
(無詞性變化)
a pair of shoes 一雙鞋
running shoes 跑鞋
Please take off your shoes at the door.
(請在門口脫鞋。)
I need a new pair of running shoes.
(我需要一雙新的跑鞋。)

shop(n./v.)商店、購物
shopping(n.)購物
shopper(n.)購物者
go shopping 去購物
coffee shop 咖啡店
Let's go shopping this weekend.
(這週末我們去購物吧。)
There is a coffee shop near my school.
(我學校附近有一家咖啡店。)

short(adj.)短的、矮的、不足的
shorten(v.)縮短
shortly(adv.)不久
be short of 缺少
for short 簡稱
My little brother is short but strong.
(我弟弟個子矮但很強壯。)
We are short of time, so hurry up.
(我們時間不夠，所以快一點。)

shorts(n.)短褲
(無詞性變化)
a pair of shorts 一件短褲
wear shorts 穿短褲
He likes to wear shorts in summer.
(他夏天喜歡穿短褲。)
I bought a pair of blue shorts.
(我買了一件藍色短褲。)

shoulder(n.)肩膀
(無詞性變化)
shoulder to shoulder 肩並肩
shrug one's shoulders 聳肩
My shoulder hurts after the game.
(比賽後我的肩膀很痛。)
She put her hand on my shoulder.
(她把手放在我的肩膀上。)

shout(v./n.)大叫、喊叫
(無詞性變化)
shout at 對⋯吼叫
shout for help 大聲呼救
Don't shout at your little sister.
(不要對你妹妹大吼。)
He shouted for help in the water.
(他在水中大聲呼救。)

show(v./n.)展示、表演、節目
(無詞性變化)
show... around 帶⋯參觀
TV show 電視節目
Can you show me the way to the station?
(你可以告訴我去車站的路嗎？)
This TV show is very funny.
(這個電視節目很好笑。)

shower(n./v.)淋浴、陣雨、淋浴
(無詞性變化)
take a shower 淋浴、洗澡
rain shower 陣雨
I take a shower every night.
(我每天晚上洗澡。)
There may be showers this afternoon.
(今天下午可能會有陣雨。)

sick(adj.)生病的、噁心的、厭倦的
sickness(n.)疾病
get sick 生病
be sick of 厭倦⋯
Tom is sick, so he is at home today.
(湯姆生病了，所以他今天在家。)
I'm sick of eating noodles every day.
(我厭倦每天吃麵了。)

side(n.)邊、側面、一方
(無詞性變化)
side by side 並排
on the other side 在另一邊
The bank is on the other side of the street.
(銀行在街道的另一邊。)
We walked side by side in the park.
(我們在公園並肩散步。)

sight(n./v.)視力、景象、看見
see(v.)看見
at first sight 一見(鍾情)
catch sight of 瞥見
The sunset was a beautiful sight.
(夕陽是一幅美麗的景象。)
They fell in love at first sight.
(他們一見鍾情。)

sign(n./v.)標誌、跡象、簽名
signature(n.)簽名
signal(n.)信號
sign up 報名
road sign 路標
Please sign your name here.
(請在這裡簽名。)
The sign says 'No Parking'.
(標誌上寫著「禁止停車」。)

simple(adj.)簡單的、樸素的
simply(adv.)簡單地、只是
simplify(v.)簡化
simple question 簡單的問題
simple life 簡樸的生活
The answer is very simple.
(答案非常簡單。)
My grandparents live a simple life.
(我的祖父母過著簡樸的生活。)

since(conj./prep./adv.)自從、既然、從那時起
(無詞性變化)
ever since 從那時起一直
since then 從那時起
I have lived here since 2015.
(我從2015年起就住在這裡。)
Since it's raining, let's stay home.
(既然在下雨，我們就待在家吧。)

sing(v.)唱歌
singer(n.)歌手
song(n.)歌曲
sing a song 唱歌
sing along 跟著唱
She sings very well.
(她唱歌唱得很好。)
Let's sing a song for Mom's birthday.
(我們為媽媽的生日唱首歌吧。)

singer(n.)歌手
sing(v.)唱歌
pop singer 流行歌手
lead singer 主唱
That singer has a beautiful voice.
(那位歌手有一副美妙的嗓音。)
She wants to be a pop singer.
(她想成為流行歌手。)

sir(n.)先生、閣下(尊稱)
(無詞性變化)
Yes, sir. 是的，先生。
Dear Sir 敬啟者
Excuse me, sir, is this your bag?
(不好意思，先生，這是您的包包嗎？)
Can I help you, sir?
(先生，需要幫忙嗎？)

sister(n.)姐妹
(無詞性變化)
older sister 姐姐
younger sister 妹妹
My older sister is a nurse.
(我姐姐是護理師。)
I play games with my little sister.
(我和我妹妹一起玩遊戲。)

sit(v.)坐
seat(n.)座位
sit down 坐下
sit up 坐直
Please sit down and have some tea.
(請坐下喝點茶。)
The cat is sitting on the sofa.
(貓正坐在沙發上。)

size(n./v.)尺寸、大小、按大小分類
(無詞性變化)
shoe size 鞋子尺寸
the same size 同樣大小
What size do you wear?
(你穿什麼尺寸？)
These two boxes are the same size.
(這兩個箱子一樣大。)

skirt(n.)裙子
(無詞性變化)
short skirt 短裙
long skirt 長裙
She wore a red skirt to the party.
(她穿了一件紅裙子去派對。)
This long skirt is very pretty.
(這件長裙很漂亮。)

sky(n.)天空
(無詞性變化)
blue sky 藍天
in the sky 在天空中
The sky is clear and blue today.
(今天的天空晴朗又湛藍。)
I saw many stars in the sky.
(我看到天空中有很多星星。)

sleep(n./v.)睡眠、睡覺
sleepy(adj.)想睡的
asleep(adj.)睡著的
go to sleep 去睡覺
fall asleep 睡著
I usually sleep eight hours a night.
(我通常每晚睡八小時。)
The baby fell asleep in my arms.
(寶寶在我懷裡睡著了。)

slim(adj.)苗條的、微小的
(無詞性變化)
slim figure 苗條的身材
slim chance 機會渺茫
She stays slim by running every day.
(她靠每天跑步保持苗條。)
Our chance of winning is slim.
(我們獲勝的機會很渺茫。)

slow(adj./v./adv.)慢的、減慢、慢慢地
slowly(adv.)慢慢地
slow down 放慢速度
slow motion 慢動作
Please slow down, I can't follow you.
(請慢一點，我跟不上你。)
My computer is very slow today.
(我的電腦今天很慢。)

small(adj./n./adv.)小的、少的
(無詞性變化)
small town 小鎮
a small amount 少量
He lives in a small town.
(他住在一個小鎮上。)
This shirt is too small for me.
(這件襯衫對我來說太小了。)

smart(adj.)聰明的、時髦的
(無詞性變化)
smart phone 智慧型手機
smart choice 明智的選擇
Amy is a smart girl.
(艾咪是個聰明的女孩。)
Taking the MRT was a smart choice.
(搭捷運是個明智的選擇。)

smell(n./v.)氣味、聞、聞起來
smelly(adj.)有臭味的
smell good 聞起來很香
sense of smell 嗅覺
The flowers smell so sweet.
(這些花聞起來好香。)
I love the smell of fresh bread.
(我愛新鮮麵包的味道。)

smile(n./v.)微笑
(無詞性變化)
smile at 對⋯微笑
a big smile 燦爛的笑容
The baby smiled at me.
(寶寶對我微笑。)
She has a big smile on her face.
(她臉上掛著燦爛的笑容。)

smoke(n./v.)煙、抽菸、冒煙
smoker(n.)吸菸者
smoking(n.)吸菸
give up smoking 戒菸
No Smoking 禁止吸菸
My dad stopped smoking last year.
(我爸爸去年戒菸了。)
Black smoke came out of the kitchen.
(黑煙從廚房冒出來。)

snake(n./v.)蛇、蜿蜒
(無詞性變化)
a poisonous snake 毒蛇
snake bite 蛇咬傷
I am afraid of snakes.
(我怕蛇。)
The river snakes through the valley.
(那條河蜿蜒流過山谷。)

snow(n./v.)雪、下雪
snowy(adj.)下雪的、多雪的
heavy snow 大雪
snow-covered 被雪覆蓋的
It often snows in Japan in winter.
(日本冬天常下雪。)
The kids played in the snow.
(孩子們在雪地裡玩。)

so(adv./conj.)如此、非常、所以
(無詞性變化)
so far 到目前為止
and so on 等等
I am so happy to see you.
(見到你我好開心。)
It was late, so we took a taxi.
(時間晚了，所以我們搭計程車。)

sofa(n.)沙發
(無詞性變化)
sit on the sofa 坐在沙發上
sofa bed 沙發床
Dad is sleeping on the sofa.
(爸爸正在沙發上睡覺。)
We bought a new sofa for the living room.
(我們為客廳買了一張新沙發。)

soldier(n.)軍人、士兵
(無詞性變化)
brave soldier 勇敢的士兵
become a soldier 當兵
My uncle was a soldier.
(我叔叔以前是軍人。)
The soldiers helped people after the flood.
(士兵們在水災後幫助民眾。)

some(adj./pron.)一些、某個
(無詞性變化)
some day 將來某天
some of 其中一些
I want some water, please.
(我想要一些水，謝謝。)
Some of my friends like basketball.
(我的一些朋友喜歡籃球。)

someone(pron./n.)某人、重要人物
somebody(pron./n.)某人(同 someone)
someone else 別人
someone special 特別的人
Someone is knocking on the door.
(有人在敲門。)
Is there someone who can help me?
(有沒有人可以幫我？)

something(pron./n.)某事、某物
(無詞性變化)
something else 別的東西
something to eat 吃的東西
I want something to drink.
(我想喝點東西。)
There is something wrong with my phone.
(我的手機有點問題。)

sometimes(adv.)有時候
(無詞性變化)
sometimes... sometimes... 有時⋯有時⋯
only sometimes 只是偶爾
Sometimes I walk to school.
(我有時候走路上學。)
He sometimes forgets his homework.
(他有時候會忘了帶作業。)

somewhere(adv.)在某處
(無詞性變化)
somewhere else 別的地方
somewhere near 附近某處
I left my keys somewhere.
